check('no date', lambda: make_path("s3://raw", "orders"), 's3://raw/orders/data.parquet')
check('with date', lambda: make_path("s3://raw", "orders", date="2026-11-27"), 's3://raw/orders/date=2026-11-27/data.parquet')
check('format', lambda: make_path("b", "t", fmt="csv"), 'b/t/data.csv')
check('both', lambda: make_path("b", "t", date="d", fmt="json"), 'b/t/date=d/data.json')
check('date positional raises', lambda: raises(lambda: make_path("b", "t", "2026-11-27"), TypeError), True)
check('unknown keyword raises', lambda: raises(lambda: make_path("b", "t", day="x"), TypeError), True)

check('fresh', lambda: add_tag({}, "pii"), ['pii'])
check('no shared state', lambda: (add_tag({}, "a"), add_tag({}, "b")), (['a'], ['b']))
check('adds to given', lambda: add_tag({}, "b", ["a"]), ['a', 'b'])
check('no duplicate', lambda: add_tag({}, "a", ["a"]), ['a'])
check('input not mutated', lambda: (lambda t: (add_tag({}, "z", t), t)[1])(["a"]), ['a'])
check('empty given', lambda: add_tag({}, "x", []), ['x'])

check('sequence', lambda: (lambda acc: [acc(1), acc(2), acc(3)])(make_accumulator()), [1, 3, 6])
check('start', lambda: make_accumulator(10)(5), 15)
check('independent', lambda: (lambda a, b: (a(1), b(100), a(1)))(make_accumulator(), make_accumulator()), (1, 100, 2))
check('negatives', lambda: (lambda acc: [acc(-1), acc(-1)])(make_accumulator()), [-1, -2])
check('floats', lambda: (lambda acc: [acc(0.5), acc(0.25)])(make_accumulator()), [0.5, 0.75])
check('zero', lambda: make_accumulator()(0), 0)

check('each factor kept', lambda: [m(10) for m in make_multipliers([1, 2, 3])], [10, 20, 30])
check('empty', lambda: make_multipliers([]), [])
check('count', lambda: len(make_multipliers(range(4))), 4)
check('strings repeat', lambda: [m("ab") for m in make_multipliers([0, 2])], ['', 'abab'])
check('negative', lambda: make_multipliers([-1])[0](4), -4)
check('one', lambda: make_multipliers([5])[0](2), 10)

check('mixed', lambda: rank([{"id": 1, "region": "s", "amount": 5}, {"id": 2, "region": "n", "amount": 5}, {"id": 3, "region": "n", "amount": 9}]), [3, 2, 1])
check('ties by id', lambda: rank([{"id": 9, "region": "n", "amount": 1}, {"id": 4, "region": "n", "amount": 1}]), [4, 9])
check('empty', lambda: rank([]), [])
check('one', lambda: rank([{"id": 1, "region": "x", "amount": 0}]), [1])
check('floats', lambda: rank([{"id": 1, "region": "a", "amount": 0.5}, {"id": 2, "region": "a", "amount": 1.5}]), [2, 1])
check('negatives', lambda: rank([{"id": 1, "region": "a", "amount": -5}, {"id": 2, "region": "a", "amount": -1}]), [2, 1])

check('strip then lower', lambda: compose(str.strip, str.lower)("  HeLLo "), 'hello')
check('identity', lambda: compose()("same"), 'same')
check('order matters', lambda: compose(lambda x: x + 1, lambda x: x * 10)(1), 20)
check('one', lambda: compose(abs)(-3), 3)
check('three', lambda: compose(str.split, len, str)("a b c"), '3')
check('reusable', lambda: (lambda f: [f(1), f(2)])(compose(lambda x: x * x)), [1, 4])

check('3x3', lambda: grid_paths(3, 3), 6)
check('3x7', lambda: grid_paths(3, 7), 28)
check('1x1', lambda: grid_paths(1, 1), 1)
check('zero', lambda: grid_paths(0, 5), 0)
check('big needs caching', lambda: grid_paths(18, 18), 2333606220)
check('one row', lambda: grid_paths(1, 50), 1)

check('decimal', lambda: to_plain(Decimal("1.10")), '1.10')
check('datetime', lambda: to_plain(datetime(2026, 11, 27, 9, 30)), '2026-11-27T09:30:00')
check('date', lambda: to_plain(date(2026, 1, 2)), '2026-01-02')
check('nested', lambda: to_plain({"a": [Decimal("1"), (2, {"b"})], "d": date(2026, 1, 1)}), {'a': ['1', [2, ['b']]], 'd': '2026-01-01'})
check('set sorted', lambda: to_plain({"b", "a"}), ['a', 'b'])
check('passthrough', lambda: to_plain(["x", 1, None, 2.5]), ['x', 1, None, 2.5])

check('result passes through', lambda: counted(lambda x, y=1: x + y)(2, y=3), 5)
check('counts', lambda: (lambda f: (f(1), f(2), f.calls)[2])(counted(abs)), 2)
check('starts at zero', lambda: counted(abs).calls, 0)
check('keeps name', lambda: counted(len).__name__, 'len')
check('keeps doc', lambda: counted(str.upper).__doc__ == str.upper.__doc__, True)
check('separate counters', lambda: (lambda a, b: (a(1), a(1), b(1), a.calls, b.calls)[3:])(counted(abs), counted(abs)), (2, 1))

check('succeeds third try', lambda: (lambda s: (lambda f: (f(), f.attempts))(retry(3)(lambda: s.pop(0)() if s else 'ok')))([lambda: 1 / 0, lambda: 1 / 0]), ('ok', 3))
check('first try', lambda: (lambda f: (f(2), f.attempts))(retry(3)(lambda x: x * 2)), (4, 1))
check('gives up', lambda: raises(lambda: retry(2)(lambda: 1 / 0)(), ZeroDivisionError), True)
check('other errors not retried', lambda: (lambda f: (raises(f, KeyError), f.attempts))(retry(5, (ValueError,))(lambda: {}['x'])), (True, 1))
check('retries listed error', lambda: (lambda f: (raises(f, ValueError), f.attempts))(retry(4, (ValueError,))(lambda: int('x'))), (True, 4))
check('keeps name', lambda: retry(2)(len).__name__, 'len')

check('insert', lambda: route({"op": "insert", "row": {"a": 1, "b": 2}}), 'insert 2 cols')
check('delete', lambda: route({"op": "delete", "id": 7}), 'delete 7')
check('delete needs int', lambda: route({"op": "delete", "id": "7"}), 'ignore')
check('upsert', lambda: route({"op": "upsert", "x": 1}), 'write upsert')
check('batch', lambda: route([{"op": "update"}, {"op": "?"}]), ['write update', 'ignore'])
check('not a dict', lambda: route("insert"), 'ignore')

check('mixed', lambda: durations(["job a took 120ms", "start", "job b took 7ms ok"]), [120, 7])
check('none', lambda: durations(["no timing"]), [])
check('empty', lambda: durations([]), [])
check('first match per line', lambda: durations(["took 1ms then took 2ms"]), [1])
check('needs ms', lambda: durations(["took 5s"]), [])
check('zero', lambda: durations(["took 0ms"]), [0])

check('found', lambda: first_match([1, 4, 6], lambda x: x % 2 == 0, -1), 4)
check('default', lambda: first_match([1, 3], lambda x: x > 5, None), None)
check('empty', lambda: first_match([], bool, "none"), 'none')
check('generator input', lambda: first_match((x * x for x in range(10)), lambda x: x > 20, 0), 25)
check('stops early', lambda: first_match((1 / x for x in [4, 0]), bool, 9), 0.25)
check('annotated', lambda: first_match.__annotations__['return'].__name__, 'T')

check('valid', lambda: validate({"order_id": 1, "status": "paid", "amount": 9.5}), [])
check('int amount ok', lambda: validate({"order_id": 1, "status": "paid", "amount": 9}), [])
check('missing', lambda: validate({"order_id": 1}), ['missing amount', 'missing status'])
check('extra and bad', lambda: validate({"order_id": "1", "status": "paid", "amount": 1.0, "x": 0}), ['bad order_id', 'extra x'])
check('bool rejected', lambda: validate({"order_id": True, "status": "s", "amount": False}), ['bad amount', 'bad order_id'])
check('empty', lambda: validate({}), ['missing amount', 'missing order_id', 'missing status'])
